name: Trials and Adversity
summary: Trials are a purposeful part of our Heavenly Father's plan, refining and strengthening us as we turn to Jesus Christ, who has power to sanctify our suffering and give us peace.
keywords: why does god let us suffer
trusting the lord when things go wrong

references.why: There must needs be opposition in all things; opposition is essential to the plan
Thine adversity and thine afflictions shall be but a small moment; endure it well
All these things shall give thee experience and shall be for thy good
The Lord gives weakness that we may be humble; He makes weak things become strong
The Lord eases and strengthens the burdens placed upon His people
In the world ye shall have tribulation; be of good cheer, I have overcome the world
All things work together for good to them that love God
I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction

quotes.text: Some blessings come soon, some come late, and some don't come until heaven; but for those who embrace the gospel of Jesus Christ, they come.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: "An High Priest of Good Things to Come," General Conference, October 1999

quotes.text: The joy we feel has little to do with the circumstances of our lives and everything to do with the focus of our lives. When the focus of our lives is on God's plan of salvation … and Jesus Christ and His gospel, we can feel joy regardless of what is happening—or not happening—in our lives.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.role: President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
quotes.source: "Joy and Spiritual Survival," General Conference, October 2016

quotes.text: Broken minds can be healed just the way broken bones and broken hearts are healed. While God is at work making those repairs, the rest of us can help by being merciful, nonjudgmental, and kind.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: "Like a Broken Vessel," General Conference, October 2013

quotes.text: Our Heavenly Father, who gives us so much to delight in, also knows that we learn and grow and become refined through hard challenges, heartbreaking sorrows, and difficult choices.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.source: "The Race of Life," General Conference, April 2012

name: Agency and Choice
summary: Because our loving Heavenly Father gave us the sacred gift of moral agency, we are free to choose liberty and eternal life through Jesus Christ, and we are accountable for the choices we make.
keywords: why did god give us choices

references.why: We are free to choose liberty and eternal life or captivity and death
Opposition in all things is essential to agency and choice
Choose you this day whom ye will serve
God grants Adam agency: thou mayest choose for thyself
Ye are free to act for yourselves, to choose good or evil
Do many good things of their own free will; agents unto themselves
Wickedness never was happiness; consequences of choices
Set before you life and death; therefore choose life

quotes.text: Agency, or the power to choose, was ours as spirit children of our Creator before the world was. It is a gift from God, nearly as precious as life itself.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: Addiction or Freedom, General Conference (Ensign, Nov. 1988)

quotes.text: Next to the bestowal of life itself, the right to direct that life is God's greatest gift to man.
quotes.author: David O. McKay
quotes.source: Teachings of Presidents of the Church: David O. McKay, ch. 22 (originally Improvement Era, Feb. 1962)

name: Overcoming Fear and Anxiety
summary: Because God is with us and His perfect love drives out fear, we can face worry, panic, and anxious hearts with courage, peace, and trust in the Savior.
keywords: cast your burden on the lord

references.why: Christ gives peace, not as the world gives; let not your heart be afraid.
God gave us not a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and a sound mind.
Perfect love casteth out fear; fear hath torment.
Fear not, for I am with thee; I will strengthen and uphold thee.
Be strong and of a good courage; the Lord is with thee wherever thou goest.
Look unto me in every thought; doubt not, fear not.
Be careful for nothing; peace of God guards heart and mind through prayer.

quotes.text: The Lord expects us to have enough faith and determination and enough trust in Him to keep moving, keep working, keep trying. Fear, which can come upon people in difficult days, is a principal weapon in the arsenal Satan uses to make mankind unhappy.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: General Conference, April 1999, "An High Priest of Good Things to Come"

quotes.text: Faith is the antidote for fear.
quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.source: General Conference, October 2015, "Faith Is Not by Chance, but by Choice"

quotes.text: The Lord counseled, 'Look unto me in every thought; doubt not, fear not.' Faith and fear cannot coexist in our minds at the same time.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference, April 2021, "Christ Is Risen; Faith in Him Will Move Mountains"

quotes.text: God did not put us on earth to fail but to succeed gloriously. It may seem paradoxical, but that is why recognizing our limitations can be a blessing.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.source: General Conference, October 2013

name: The Atonement of Jesus Christ
summary: Through His suffering in Gethsemane, His death on the cross, and His glorious Resurrection, Jesus Christ paid the price for our sins and sorrows, offering redemption, healing, and the power to be made whole to all who come unto Him.
keywords: why did jesus have to die
how can i feel clean again

references.why: Redemption comes through the grace and mercy of the Holy Messiah
Christ bleeds at every pore, suffering for the sins of the world
He took upon Him our pains, sicknesses, and infirmities to succor His people
He was wounded for our transgressions; with His stripes we are healed
Christ's own account of suffering so we might not suffer if we repent
God gave His Only Begotten Son that we might not perish but have eternal life
In Gethsemane He submitted to the Father's will, sweating as it were great drops of blood
Christ was lifted up to draw all men unto Him and to be judged of their works

quotes.text: Most of us clearly understand that the Atonement is for sinners. I am not so sure, however, that we know and understand that the Atonement is also for saints—for good men and women who are obedient, worthy, and conscientious and who are striving to become better and serve more faithfully.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.source: The Atonement and the Journey of Mortality, Ensign, April 2012

quotes.text: I testify that no one of us is less treasured or cherished of God than another. I testify that He loves each of us—insecurities, anxieties, self-image, and all. He doesn't measure our talents or our looks; He doesn't measure our professions or our possessions.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: The Other Prodigal, General Conference, April 2002

quotes.text: It was in Gethsemane that Jesus took on Himself the sins of the world, in Gethsemane that His pain was equivalent to the cumulative burden of all men, in Gethsemane that He descended below all things so that all could repent and come to Him.
quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson
quotes.source: Come Unto Christ (1983); quoted in From the Garden to the Empty Tomb, Liahona/Ensign, April 2006

name: The Law of Chastity
summary: The law of chastity is God's standard of moral purity—reserving sexual relations for marriage between a man and a woman—by which we honor the sacred power to create life and keep our bodies and spirits clean before the Lord.

references.why: The commandment 'Thou shalt not commit adultery' from the Decalogue.
Flee fornication; the body is the temple of the Holy Ghost.
Christ teaches that lust in the heart is a form of adultery.
Sexual sins are an abomination, most serious next to murder and denying the Holy Ghost.
The Lord delights in the chastity of His children.
Let virtue garnish thy thoughts unceasingly; confidence and the Spirit follow purity.
Chastity and virtue are described as most dear and precious above all things.
Love spouse and none else; those who lust shall not have the Spirit and shall deny the faith.

quotes.text: Do not have any sexual relations before marriage, and be completely faithful to your spouse after marriage.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.source: For the Strength of Youth pamphlet / repeated counsel

quotes.text: Physical intimacy between husband and wife is beautiful and sacred. It is ordained of God for the creation of children and for the expression of love between husband and wife.
quotes.author: The First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve
quotes.role: First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
quotes.source: The Family: A Proclamation to the World

quotes.text: Sexual intimacy is not only a symbol of the union between husband and wife but is also a means of expressing it.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: Of Souls, Symbols, and Sacraments, BYU Devotional

quotes.text: In matters of human intimacy, you must wait until after marriage with your husband or wife. This is the Lord's law of chastity. It is His way to protect the sanctity and power of procreation.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference

name: Covenants and Baptism
summary: Covenants are sacred, two-way promises with God that begin at baptism and are renewed each week through the sacrament, placing us on and keeping us on the covenant path home to Him.
keywords: making and keeping promises to god

references.why: Baptism as the gate to the covenant path; endure to the end after entering.
Alma defines the baptismal covenant: bear one another's burdens, stand as witnesses of God.
Jesus is baptized to fulfil all righteousness, the pattern for all.
Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
Baptism as burial and resurrection, walking in newness of life.
The requirements and meaning of baptism into the Church.
Baptism follows a broken heart; members are then numbered and nourished.
The sacramental prayers by which we renew our covenant to always remember Christ.

quotes.text: Making covenants with God is a great blessing. Keeping those covenants is even a greater blessing. And the greatest blessings come as we live true to the covenants we have made.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: The reward for keeping covenants with God is heavenly power—power that strengthens us to withstand our trials, temptations, and heartaches better. This power eases our way.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: "The Everlasting Covenant," Liahona / General Conference

quotes.text: Each Sunday we witness anew our willingness to take upon us the name of Jesus Christ as we partake of the emblems of His body and blood. In doing so, we renew our baptismal covenant.
quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.role: First Presidency, Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
quotes.source: "Sacrament Meeting and the Sacrament," General Conference

quotes.text: The word remember is the most important word in the sacramental prayers. We covenant that we will always remember Him.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: "This Do in Remembrance of Me," General Conference

name: Doubt and Questions
summary: Honest questions and even wrestling with unbelief can become doorways to deeper faith when we bring them humbly to the Lord and act on the light we already have.
keywords: how do i get answers to prayers

references.why: Father's cry, 'Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.'
If any lack wisdom, ask of God, but ask in faith, nothing wavering.
Experiment on the word; even a desire to believe can begin faith.
'Look unto me in every thought; doubt not, fear not.'
Study it out, then ask; the Lord confirms answers to sincere seekers.
Faith is things hoped for and not seen; dispute not because ye see not.
Ask, seek, knock—the promise to those with honest questions.
Joseph's honest question, prompted by James 1:5, opens the Restoration.

quotes.text: So be as candid about your questions as you need to be; life is full of them on one subject or another. But if you and your family want to be healed, don't let those questions stand in the way of faith working its miracle... I am not asking you to pretend to faith you do not have. I am asking you to be true to the faith you do have.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: "Lord, I Believe," General Conference

quotes.text: My dear brothers and sisters, my dear friends, please, first doubt your doubts before you doubt your faith.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: "Come, Join with Us," General Conference

quotes.text: My dear friends, there is so much that we do not yet understand in this life that requires our patience... You know enough, my dear brothers and sisters. You know enough to make the choices that will define who you will be and what your eternity will be.
quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.source: "You Know Enough," General Conference

quotes.text: It's natural to have questions—the acorn of honest inquiry has often sprouted and matured into a great oak of understanding. There are few members of the Church who, at one time or another, have not wrestled with serious or sensitive questions.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: "Come, Join with Us," General Conference

name: Faith in Jesus Christ
summary: Faith in Jesus Christ is a living principle of trust in the Savior that moves us to act, draws down His power, and becomes the foundation for all righteousness and hope.
keywords: faith as a principle of action
how do i know god is real

references.why: Classic definition: faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen.
Faith is not to have a perfect knowledge but to hope for things which are not seen, which are true.
Invitation to experiment upon the word and exercise even a particle of faith.
Faith is things hoped for and not seen; a witness comes only after the trial of your faith.
All things are possible to him that believeth; 'Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief.'
Christ: if ye have faith in me ye shall have power to do whatsoever thing is expedient in me.
Faith as a grain of mustard seed can move mountains; nothing shall be impossible.
Faith without works is dead; faith is shown by works, making it a principle of action.

quotes.text: Faith takes work. Receiving revelation takes work. … Your growing faith in Him will move mountains—not the mountains of rock that beautify the earth but the mountains of misery in your lives.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: Christ Is Risen; Faith in Him Will Move Mountains, April 2021 General Conference

quotes.text: Faith in the Lord Jesus Christ is not something ethereal, floating loosely in the air. Faith does not fall upon us by chance or stay with us by birthright. … Faith is a principle of power, important not only in this life but also in our progression beyond the veil.
quotes.author: Neil L. Andersen
quotes.source: Faith Is Not by Chance, but by Choice, October 2015 General Conference

quotes.text: Faith and doubt cannot exist in the same mind at the same time, for one will dispel the other.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.source: Be an Example and a Light, October 2015 General Conference

quotes.text: Faith is like the muscle of my arm. If I use it, if I nurture it, it grows strong; it will do many things. But if I put it in a sling and do nothing with it, it will grow weak and useless, and so will it be with you.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.role: First Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: Lord, Increase Our Faith, October 1987 General Conference

name: Family and Marriage
summary: Marriage between a man and a woman and the family are ordained of God, central to His plan of happiness, and can be bound together eternally through sacred temple covenants.
keywords: how to have a happy family
the family a proclamation to the world

references.why: A man cleaves unto his wife and they become one flesh.
Hearts of fathers and children turned to each other; sealing power.
What God has joined together, let not man put asunder.
Neither is the man without the woman, nor the woman without the man, in the Lord.
The new and everlasting covenant of marriage required for exaltation.
Marriage sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise endures eternally.
Parents teaching children to love, serve, and walk uprightly.
It is not good that man should be alone; God ordained companionship.

quotes.text: The family is central to the Creator's plan for the eternal destiny of His children. Marriage between a man and a woman is ordained of God and the family is central to His plan for the eternal destiny of His children.
quotes.author: The First Presidency and Council of the Twelve Apostles
quotes.role: First Presidency and Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
quotes.source: The Family: A Proclamation to the World

quotes.text: Our Heavenly Father wants husbands and wives to be faithful to each other and to esteem and treat their children as an heritage from the Lord.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: However late you think you are, however many chances you think you have missed, however many mistakes you feel you have made or talents you think you don't have, or however far from home and family and God you feel you have traveled, I testify that you have not traveled beyond the reach of divine love.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: General Conference, April 2012

quotes.text: No other success can compensate for failure in the home.
quotes.author: David O. McKay
quotes.source: General Conference, quoting J. E. McCulloch

name: Fasting
summary: Fasting, when joined with prayer and generous fast offerings, humbles the soul, invites revelation and spiritual power, and turns our hearts toward God and the needs of others.

references.why: Defines the true fast: loosing bands of wickedness, feeding the hungry
Fast unto the Father in secret, not to be seen of men
Offer whole souls to God through fasting and continued faith
Fasting and prayer bring the spirit of prophecy and revelation
Fasting and prayer yield sanctification and the purifying of hearts
The Saints met oft to fast and pray and speak of their souls
Fasting is to be done with joy and a glad heart
Alma fasts and prays for his son to be restored

quotes.text: A proper fast day observance consists of abstaining from food and drink for two consecutive meals, attending fast and testimony meeting, and giving a generous fast offering to help care for those in need.
quotes.author: Joseph B. Wirthlin
quotes.source: The Law of the Fast, General Conference April 2001

quotes.text: Fasting, coupled with mighty prayer, is powerful. It can fill our minds with the revelations of the Spirit. It can strengthen us against times of temptation.
quotes.author: Howard W. Hunter
quotes.source: Fast Day, Ensign November 1985

quotes.text: When we fast, brethren and sisters, we feel hunger. And for a short time, we literally put ourselves in the position of the hungry and the needy. As we do so, we have greater understanding of the deprivations they might feel.
quotes.author: L. Tom Perry
quotes.source: The Law of the Fast, General Conference April 1986

quotes.text: The Lord has promised His people that they can gain spiritual strength and power through fasting. Fasting is one of the ways we can draw closer to the Lord and receive His blessings.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference

name: Forgiving Others
summary: To forgive those who have hurt us is to lay down the burden of offense and let the healing, redeeming mercy of Jesus Christ make us whole.

references.why: Forgive not seven times but seventy times seven
If ye forgive men their trespasses, your Heavenly Father will also forgive you
Of you it is required to forgive all men; the Lord will forgive whom He will
Forgive, and ye shall be forgiven
Put away bitterness; be kind, tenderhearted, forgiving as God forgave you in Christ
Forbearing and forgiving one another, even as Christ forgave you
Christ on the cross: Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do
Ye shall forgive one another; he that forgiveth not standeth condemned

quotes.text: When our hearts are filled with the love of God, we become "kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving."
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: The Merciful Obtain Mercy, General Conference

quotes.text: The Savior has offered to all of us a precious peace through His Atonement, but this can come only as we are willing to cast out negative feelings of anger, spite, or revenge.
quotes.author: James E. Faust
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: The Healing Power of Forgiveness, General Conference

quotes.text: Somehow forgiveness, with love and tolerance, accomplishes miracles that can happen in no other way.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.source: Forgiveness, General Conference

name: Feeling Forgiven
summary: Because of Jesus Christ's Atonement, sincere repentance brings not only God's forgiveness but the peace of conscience and cleansing that lets us set down guilt and truly feel forgiven.
keywords: how do i know i'm forgiven
i can't let go of my sin
why do i still feel guilty after repenting

references.why: Scarlet sins made white as snow — the promise of cleansing.
The Lord forgives the repentant and remembers their sins no more.
God blots out transgressions and will not remember our sins.
Guilt swept away, filled with joy and peace of conscience.
Enos's sins forgiven and his guilt swept away.
Alma could remember his sins and pains no more after mercy.
Christ does not condemn; go and sin no more.

quotes.text: Save for the exceptions of the very few who defect to perdition, there is no habit, no addiction, no rebellion, no transgression, no apostasy, no crime exempted from the promise of complete forgiveness.
quotes.author: Boyd K. Packer
quotes.role: President of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles
quotes.source: The Brilliant Morning of Forgiveness, General Conference

quotes.text: There is something in many of us that particularly fails to forgive and forget earlier mistakes in life—either our mistakes or the mistakes of others. It is not good. It is not Christian. It stands in terrible opposition to the grandeur and majesty of the Atonement of Christ. To be tied to earlier mistakes is a form of not forgiving ourselves.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: Remember Lot's Wife, BYU Devotional

quotes.text: Sometimes we don't recognize the Savior standing at the door, knocking, offering us the gift of forgiveness. Because of the Atonement of Jesus Christ, we can be cleansed. We can become worthy and virtuous.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: You Can Do It Now!, General Conference

quotes.text: Some of you may still feel the burden and pain of sins from the past. To you I say: Let it go. The Lord has promised, 'He who has repented of his sins, the same is forgiven, and I, the Lord, remember them no more.'
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: The Gift of Grace, General Conference

name: The Restoration
summary: Through the Prophet Joseph Smith, God restored the fulness of the gospel, priesthood authority, and the Church of Jesus Christ in these latter days, opening the heavens once again.
keywords: why do we need a restoration

references.why: Joseph Smith's guiding verse that led him to pray in the grove
Joseph's own account of the First Vision of the Father and the Son
Foretells the times of restitution of all things
The dispensation of the fulness of times gathering all things in Christ
The Lord works through revelation to His prophets
The restored Church declared the only true and living church
Angelic ministrations restoring keys, priesthood, and doctrine
Prophecy of a choice seer, Joseph Smith, in the last days

quotes.text: The First Vision made incontrovertibly clear that the doctrine of the trinity, as then maintained in the Christian world, was false. God the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ, appeared as separate, distinct, embodied personages.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference, April 2020

quotes.text: The Restoration is a process, not an event, and will continue until the Lord comes again and beyond.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: "Let God Prevail," General Conference, October 2020

quotes.text: There is no salvation without a Savior. And there is no restoration of the gospel of Jesus Christ without the Book of Mormon.
quotes.author: Tad R. Callister
quotes.source: General Conference, October 2017

quotes.text: Joseph Smith, the boy prophet, restored the gospel of Jesus Christ. Through him the priesthood of God was restored to the earth, with all its power and authority.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.source: "Praise to the Man," General Conference, April 1994

name: The Love of God
summary: God's love for each of His children is perfect, infinite, and personal—He knows us by name, treasures the worth of every soul, and reaches out to us with an everlasting love.
keywords: how much does god love me

references.why: The worth of souls is great in the sight of God.
God so loved the world that He gave His Only Begotten Son.
Nothing can separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus.
'I have loved thee with an everlasting love.'
God is love; we love Him because He first loved us.
The love of God is the most desirable and most joyous of all things.
God will not forget us; He has graven us upon the palms of His hands.
God's work and glory is the immortality and eternal life of His children.

quotes.text: God's love is so great that He loves even the proud, the selfish, the arrogant, and the wicked.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: The Love of God, General Conference, October 2009

quotes.text: However late you think you are, however many chances you think you have missed, however many mistakes you feel you have made or talents you think you don't have, or however far from home and family and God you feel you have traveled, I testify that you have not traveled beyond the reach of divine love.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: The Laborers in the Vineyard, General Conference, April 2012

quotes.text: God's love is infinite and it will endure forever, but what it means for each of us depends on how we respond to His love.
quotes.author: D. Todd Christofferson
quotes.source: Abide in My Love, General Conference, October 2016

name: Grace of Christ
summary: Through the grace of Jesus Christ we receive not only forgiveness of sin but also a divine enabling power that strengthens us to do and become more than we ever could on our own.
keywords: grace after all we can do
i can do all things through christ
not strong enough on my own

references.why: We are saved by grace, after all we can do.
Weak things become strong through Christ's grace.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
My grace is sufficient; strength made perfect in weakness.
Come unto Christ; by His grace we are perfected.
Grace for grace until receiving a fulness.
Of His fulness we all receive, grace for grace.
In His strength I can do all things; boast in God.

quotes.text: The Savior's Atonement... provides grace... a divine means of help or strength, given through the bounteous mercy and love of Jesus Christ. It is also an enabling power that allows men and women to lay hold on eternal life and exaltation after they have expended their own best efforts.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.source: "In the Strength of the Lord," BYU / General Conference

quotes.text: Divine grace is needed by every soul in consequence of the fall of Adam and also because of man's weaknesses and shortcomings. However, grace cannot suffice without total effort on the part of the recipient.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.source: "The Gift of Grace," General Conference

quotes.text: Because of the Fall of Adam and Eve and the physical and spiritual death that resulted, no unclean thing can dwell in the presence of God. We simply cannot get there on our own. Only through the grace and mercy and merits of the Holy Messiah can we return.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.source: "The Gift of Grace," General Conference

quotes.text: It's not just that the Savior helped us reach the finish line but that He carried us the whole way. His grace is not a booster rocket that engages only after we exhaust our own fuel; it is present through every step.
quotes.author: Brad Wilcox
quotes.role: BYU Devotional / Second Counselor, Young Men General Presidency
quotes.source: "His Grace Is Sufficient," BYU Devotional

name: Gratitude
summary: Gratitude is a heaven-sent disposition of the heart that, by prompting us to recognize and thank God for every blessing, deepens our joy, sanctifies our trials, and draws us nearer to the Giver of all good gifts.

references.why: In every thing give thanks, for this is the will of God concerning you.
Live in thanksgiving daily for mercies and blessings God bestows upon you.
Thou shalt thank the Lord thy God in all things.
God is offended when we confess not his hand in all things.
King Benjamin teaches we are unprofitable servants, ever indebted to God.
Let the peace of God rule in your hearts; and be ye thankful.
He who receives all things with thankfulness shall be made glorious.

quotes.text: My beloved brothers and sisters, we can lift ourselves and others as well when we refuse to remain in the realm of negative thought and cultivate within our hearts an attitude of gratitude.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.source: The Divine Gift of Gratitude, General Conference, October 2010

quotes.text: The Lord has said plainly that those who receive all things with thankfulness shall be made glorious, and the things of this earth shall be added unto them, even an hundred fold, yea, more.
quotes.author: Bonnie D. Parkin
quotes.source: Gratitude: A Path to Happiness, General Conference, April 2007

quotes.text: As we cultivate a grateful attitude, we are more likely to be happy and spiritually strong. We should regularly express our gratitude to God for blessing us with life and reason.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: Grateful in Any Circumstances, General Conference, April 2014

quotes.text: Being grateful in times of distress does not mean that we are pleased with our circumstances. It does mean that through the eyes of faith we look beyond our present-day challenges.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.role: Second Counselor in the First Presidency
quotes.source: Grateful in Any Circumstances, General Conference, April 2014

name: Grief and Loss
summary: In our seasons of sorrow and loss, the Savior—who bore our griefs—offers real comfort, healing, and the sure hope of reunion through His Atonement and Resurrection.
keywords: how to comfort those who mourn
how do i deal with grief
why does it hurt so much

references.why: Blessed are they that mourn, for they shall be comforted.
Christ's peace given to calm troubled, grieving hearts.
God shall wipe away all tears; no more death or sorrow.

quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: How do we hallow the Sabbath day? In my much younger years, I studied the work of others who had compiled lists of things to do and things not to do on the Sabbath. It wasn't until later that I learned from the scriptures that my conduct and my attitude on the Sabbath constituted a sign between me and my Heavenly Father. With that understanding, I no longer needed lists of dos and don'ts. When I had to make a decision whether or not an activity was appropriate for the Sabbath, I simply asked myself, 'What sign do I want to give to God?' That question made my choices about the Sabbath day crystal clear.

quotes.author: L. Tom Perry
quotes.source: The Sabbath and the Sacrament, General Conference

quotes.text: The Sabbath day and the ordinances administered on that day are lasting reminders that we may retain a remission of our sins through the atonement of Jesus Christ.
quotes.author: L. Tom Perry
quotes.source: The Sabbath and the Sacrament, General Conference

name: Studying the Scriptures
summary: Daily immersion in the word of God through searching, pondering, and feasting upon the scriptures draws us closer to Christ, invites revelation, and strengthens us against every temptation.
keywords: reading the bible and book of mormon

references.why: Feast upon the words of Christ, which tell all things to do.
Meditate on the law day and night for prosperity and success.
Search the scriptures; they testify of Christ.
All scripture is given by inspiration and is profitable for instruction.
The word of Christ points the course to eternal life, like the Liahona.
The word of God divides asunder cunning and leads to the tree of life.
Liken the scriptures unto ourselves for our profit and learning.
Search these commandments; the Lord's word shall all be fulfilled.

quotes.text: When individual family members immerse themselves in the scriptures regularly and consistently, this will most likely lead to family scripture study.
quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.source: The Power of Scripture, General Conference

quotes.text: I promise that as you daily immerse yourselves in the Book of Mormon, you can be immunized against the evils of the day, even the gripping plague of pornography and other mind-numbing addictions.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: The Book of Mormon: What Would Your Life Be Like Without It?, General Conference

quotes.text: My dear brothers and sisters, I promise that as you prayerfully study the Book of Mormon every day, you will make better decisions—every day.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: The Book of Mormon: What Would Your Life Be Like Without It?, General Conference

quotes.text: Reading, studying, and pondering are not the same as feasting. Reading is essential; and pondering, in which the heart and mind converge, brings understanding; but only feasting is a joyous, wholehearted participation.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.source: A Reservoir of Living Water, CES Fireside

name: The Second Coming
summary: The Second Coming of Jesus Christ is the sure and glorious promise that our Savior will return in power and glory to reign on the earth, calling each of us to watch, prepare, and stand ready with hope rather than fear.
keywords: are we living in the last days
how to prepare for the second coming
no man knoweth the day or hour

references.why: Christ teaches to watch, for no one knows the day or hour of His coming
Parable of the ten virgins: be prepared, for the Bridegroom cometh
Restoration account detailing signs preceding the Son of Man's coming
Signs of the times and the Lord's promise to appear in glory
If ye are prepared ye shall not fear the coming events
Prepare ye the way; the Lord shall stand upon the earth
The great and dreadful day of the Lord that burns as an oven
Behold, he cometh with clouds; every eye shall see him

quotes.text: The Second Coming of the Lord will be grand. It will be glorious. And it will be terrible for those who are unprepared. But I do not fear that day, and I hope you don't either. We can face the future with peace and assurance if we are prepared to receive Him.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference, October 2021

quotes.text: We need not be afraid of the days ahead. We can be filled with faith. We can meet the future with peace and assurance if we will hold fast to the words of the Lord and keep His commandments.
quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: Wherever we go, our banner is that we are disciples of the living Lord Jesus Christ. As the world drifts from its spiritual moorings, the Lord's disciples must strive even harder to prepare for His coming.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: The final outcome is certain—the forces of righteousness will finally win. What remains uncertain is where each of us personally, now and in the future, will stand in this fight—and how tall we will stand.
quotes.author: Jeffrey R. Holland
quotes.source: General Conference, April 2007

name: Service and Charity
summary: As we love and serve one another, we grow in charity, the pure love of Christ, and draw nearer to our Savior by becoming His hands to those around us.
keywords: when you serve others you serve god

references.why: When you serve others you are only in the service of your God.
Charity is the pure love of Christ that endures forever.
The two great commandments: love God and love your neighbor.
A new commandment to love one another as Christ loved us.
Serving the least of these is serving the Savior Himself.
Paul's defining description of charity's attributes.
By love serve one another.
Imparting to those in need to retain a remission of sins.

quotes.text: Charity is the pure love of Christ. It is manifest in patience, kindness, hope, and love. It is the antidote to fear, judgment, and hate.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: God does notice us, and he watches over us. But it is usually through another person that he meets our needs.
quotes.author: Spencer W. Kimball
quotes.source: "Small Acts of Service," Ensign

quotes.text: When we are engaged in the service of our fellowmen, not only do our deeds assist them, but we put our own problems in a fresher perspective.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: Ministering is the Savior's way of caring for individuals. It is loving one another as He has loved us.
quotes.author: Jean B. Bingham
quotes.source: General Conference

name: Temples and Family History
summary: In holy temples we make sacred covenants and receive ordinances that bind families together forever, and through family history we extend those same blessings to our ancestors on both sides of the veil.

references.why: Elijah to turn hearts of the fathers to children before the Lord's coming
The dead cannot be made perfect without us, nor we without them
Faithful dead continue redeeming work; the living seal families across the veil
Paul's reference to baptism for the dead
Marriage sealed by the Holy Spirit of Promise endures into eternity
Ordinances of the house of the Lord revealed for the salvation of the living and dead
The gospel preached to the dead so they may be judged and live in the spirit
Keys of the kingdom: what is bound on earth is bound in heaven

quotes.text: The temple lies at the center of strengthening our faith and spiritual fortitude because the Savior and His doctrine are the very heart of the temple. Everything taught in the temple, through instruction and through the Spirit, increases our understanding of Jesus Christ.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference, April 2021, "The Temple and Your Spiritual Foundation"

quotes.text: Any work you do in the temple is time well spent, but receiving ordinances vicariously for one of your own ancestors will make the time in the temple more sacred, and even greater blessings will be received.
quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.source: General Conference, October 2012, "The Joy of Redeeming the Dead"

quotes.text: The Spirit of Elijah is a manifestation of the Holy Ghost bearing witness of the divine nature of the family.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: General Conference, October 1994, "A New Harvest Time"

quotes.text: It is a fundamental truth that, through the atonement of Christ, we can be cleansed. We can become virtuous and pure. However, sometimes we make mistakes... Temple and family history work provides just such an opportunity.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar
quotes.source: General Conference, October 2011, "The Hearts of the Children Shall Turn"

name: Tithing and Sacrifice
summary: Tithing and sacrifice are joyful acts of faith and consecration through which we return a portion of what God has given us, opening the windows of heaven and drawing our hearts nearer to Him.
keywords: do i pay on gross or net

references.why: Robbing God; bring tithes, and He opens the windows of heaven
The law defining tithing as one-tenth of interest annually
Abraham paid tithes of all to Melchizedek, an early pattern
Promise of overflowing blessings for faithful tithe-payers
The widow's two mites—sacrifice measured by the heart
Offer whole souls as an offering; give of substance to God
He that is tithed shall not be burned at His coming
Offerings mean little without charity to the needy

quotes.text: It is not so much the amount of tithing we pay as it is the goodness of our hearts that determines the outcome of blessings and the growth of our faith and testimony.
quotes.author: Dallin H. Oaks
quotes.source: General Conference, April 1994

quotes.text: The payment of tithing has less to do with money, but more to do with faith.
quotes.author: Lynn G. Robbins
quotes.source: General Conference, April 2005

quotes.text: The Lord will open the windows of heaven and shower down blessings upon those who live the law of tithing.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.source: General Conference, April 1982

quotes.text: Every time I hear an appeal for another program, the fundamental need of the people is not money. It is faith. Tithing is a matter of faith.
quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley
quotes.source: General Conference, April 1982

name: Work and Self-Reliance
summary: The Lord asks us to labor diligently, live providently, and become self-reliant so that we can care for ourselves and generously lift others.

references.why: By the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread; work as a lasting condition.
If any would not work, neither should he eat.
Nephi teaches his people to be industrious and labor with their hands.
Service and labor for others is service to God.
Thou shalt not be idle; the idler shall not eat the bread of the laborer.
Establish a house of order, a house of God, through diligent effort.
The ant provides in summer; a call to industry and foresight.
God's own work and labor is the exaltation of His children.

quotes.text: Work is a spiritual necessity as well as an economic necessity.
quotes.author: Marion G. Romney
quotes.source: The Celestial Nature of Self-Reliance, General Conference / Ensign

quotes.text: The Lord has commanded us to be independent and self-reliant, for self-reliance is a product of our work and undergirds all other welfare practices.
quotes.author: Marion G. Romney
quotes.source: The Celestial Nature of Self-Reliance, Ensign

quotes.text: Let us work for what we need. Let us be self-reliant and independent. Salvation can be obtained on no other principle.
quotes.author: Heber J. Grant
quotes.source: Relief Society Magazine, quoted in Church welfare teachings

quotes.text: The whole objective is to build character in members of the Church, patriarchs and children, working together.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson
quotes.source: Guiding Principles of Personal and Family Welfare, General Conference

name: Self-Worth and Identity
summary: Because you are a beloved child of God with a divine nature and eternal destiny, your worth is infinite and unchanging, no matter how you feel or how you compare to others.

references.why: The worth of souls is great in the sight of God.
God created humankind in His own image and likeness.
We are children of God and joint-heirs with Christ.
God's work and glory centers on the immortality and eternal life of His children.
The Lord looks on the heart, not outward appearance or comparison.
God's love makes us His sons, and we shall be like Him.
God knew and set us apart before we were born, affirming inherent worth.

quotes.text: You are literally a child of God, spiritually begotten in the premortal life. As His child, you can be assured that you have divine, eternal potential and that He will help you in your sincere efforts to reach that potential.
quotes.author: Richard G. Scott
quotes.source: General Conference

quotes.text: You are a child of God the Eternal Father and may become like Him if you will have faith in His Son, repent, receive ordinances, receive the Holy Ghost, and endure to the end.
quotes.author: Dieter F. Uchtdorf
quotes.source: General Conference, "The Reflection in the Water"

quotes.text: Who are you? First and foremost, you are a child of God. Second, as a member of the Church, you are a child of the covenant. And third, you are a disciple of Jesus Christ.
quotes.author: Russell M. Nelson
quotes.source: Worldwide Youth Devotional, "Hope of Israel"

quotes.text: God does not begin by asking about our ability, but only about our availability, and if we then prove our dependability, he will increase our capability.
quotes.author: Neal A. Maxwell
quotes.source: General Conference, "It's Service, Not Status, That Counts"
